card.name: End of condition names in warnings
card.fires_on: The last word of a disease or condition name in warning text, such as the V in HBV, 'syndrome', 'conditions' after 'caution in', or 'deficiency' after G6PD. It comes just before a risk or reactivation statement.

modes.label: HBV abbreviation
modes.description: The final letter piece of HBV when hepatitis B reactivation is discussed.
